request.style: English, gentle children's song, warm female lead vocal with children's choir, nylon-string guitar, glockenspiel, soft piano, light shaker, quiet and wondering, 96 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the temple late at night
The lamp of God was burning bright
Little Samuel lay down
Then he heard a calling sound
Samuel, Samuel
He jumped up and ran to Eli
Here I am; you called me
I did not call. Go back and lie down

[Chorus]
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Ears wide open, sitting still
Tell me, LORD, and I will

[Verse]
Once again the voice came near
Samuel, Samuel, can you hear
Up he got and ran once more
Down the hall to Eli's door
Here I am; you called me
I did not call, my son
A third time the LORD called Samuel
Then Eli understood

[Chorus]
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Ears wide open, sitting still
Tell me, LORD, and I will

[Bridge]
Then the LORD came and stood there
Calling as before
Samuel! Samuel!
Speak, for your servant is listening
Samuel grew up, and the LORD was with him

[Chorus]
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Speak, LORD, for your servant is listening
Ears wide open, sitting still
Tell me, LORD, and I will
